title: String And Sand
description: This datapack adds crafting recipes for string and sand
body:
Sometimes you need string or sand.
This datapack helps to get it faster by adding multiple crafting recipes.
You need for string 4 leaves and for sand 4 cobblestone.
hopefully it helps getting string and sand.

NOTE: This Project wasn't made by KeincraftTV! It's a project from Joniadam! It's just a bug cause the project is in the organization Catfish Studios!
